subject: Clarification requested — auxiliary model routing charges on Oct invoice
messages:
From: Claire Donovan <claire@nimbleapps.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-11T08:34:12-05:00
Subject: Clarification requested — auxiliary model routing charges on Oct invoice

Hi Connor,

We're reviewing the October invoice (attached) and see a line item labelled 'auxiliary model routing — surcharge' that increased our token spend by ~16% versus prior month (~$12,300 delta). I haven't seen this charge before and it isn't called out in the SOW.

Can you:
- Explain what triggered the routing surcharge and why it applied to our account in October
- Provide sample request IDs/timestamps so we can correlate with our logs
- Confirm whether VAT was calculated on the surcharge (we're EU VAT-exempt but still need the tax breakdown)

We attached the invoice (Invoice_October_2026_NimbleApps.pdf). This is blocking our AP team from releasing payment — please advise next steps.

Thanks,
Claire Donovan
Finance Lead, NimbleApps
claire@nimbleapps.com

Attachments: Invoice_October_2026_NimbleApps.pdf
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Claire Donovan <claire@nimbleapps.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-11T09:08:45-05:00
Subject: Re: Clarification requested — auxiliary model routing charges on Oct invoice

Hi Claire — thanks for flagging this. I'm looping in Ben (billing) and Kimberly (account ops) to pull the relevant routing and metering logs.

Preliminary notes: we have an auxiliary routing feature that can route to alternate model variants when primary endpoints hit capacity or during a regional failover. Those fallback routes can carry a different unit cost and may account for the delta you're seeing. That said, the charge should have been surfaced in the plan addendum if it was enabled deliberately for your account.

Can you please share a small set of request IDs and a preferred date/time window (UTC) to check against our logs? If helpful, we'll export the raw routing decisions and token breakdown for the window and propose a corrective credit if we find misrouting.

I'll prioritize this — aiming to get an initial log export to you within 24 hours.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.com

- req_9a3b4c2d
- req_9a3b4c9f

One contractual note: our SOW (section 4.2) says fallback routing should be pre-approved or treated as billable only if explicitly enabled by the customer. We never requested auxiliary routing for Oct. Please advise urgently — AP wants to clear the invoice but will not until we resolve this.

Claire

Attachments: exported-requests-nimble-20261027.csv (uploaded to Drive)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-11T13:41:09-05:00
Subject: Re: Clarification requested — auxiliary model routing charges on Oct invoice

Connor / Kim — I pulled the routing logs for NimbleApps for 2026-10-27. Summary of findings: 

- At ~2026-10-27T02:11:54Z an autoscaling event in our EU region triggered a temporary policy flip in the routing layer for accounts on the 'fallbackToLatest' policy.
- For NimbleApps specifically, 3,412 requests in the 02:12 — 03:28 UTC window were routed to redwood-xl-2.9b (auxiliary variant) instead of the pinned 'redwood-micro-1.7b' primary model.
- The auxiliary variant's per-token metering is measured against its own pricing band; net token consumption for the window was 6,820,412 tokens on the auxiliary model vs 3,121,204 tokens expected on the primary variant under the same requests. The delta explains the ~16% invoice increase.

I've attached a short CSV with the routing decisions and per-request token deltas for that window (routing-log-snippet-20261027.csv). Initial recommendation: we offer a corrective credit that refunds the token-delta cost for requests that were routed to the auxiliary model without explicit account opt-in.

Proposed corrective adjustment:
- Token delta cost (list price): $12,320.00
- Apply internal courtesy discount (we bear 40% of surcharge): negative adjustment to NimbleApps: $4,928.00 credit
- VAT handling: NimbleApps is VAT-exempt in our system, but credits must mirror the original tax treatment. For the credit we will: 1) issue credit note net of VAT (no VAT applied) and 2) include a short explanation on the credit memo that references Invoice #Oct-2026 and the routing incident.

If Connor/Kim approve, I'll create the credit memo and route to accounting to offset against the outstanding invoice.

Attachments: routing-log-snippet-20261027.csv

—Ben
Ben Carter
Sr. Revenue Operations Analyst, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Claire Donovan <claire@nimbleapps.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@nimbleapps.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T14:02:01-08:00
Subject: Re: Clarification requested — auxiliary model routing charges on Oct invoice

Claire — thanks for your patience, and apologies for the disruption. Quick summary and next steps: 

1) Root cause: an autoscaling routing flip caused ~3.4k requests to be routed to an auxiliary model (redwood-xl-2.9b) between 2026-10-27T02:12Z and 2026-10-27T03:28Z. These requests incurred a measurable token delta versus your pinned primary model.

2) Credit offer: Redwood will issue a credit memo to NimbleApps for $4,928.00 (net), which represents our proposed share of the surcharge. The credit will be net of VAT consistent with how the original invoice was issued. Ben will generate the credit memo and route it to accounting.

3) Evidence: attached are the exported requests (exported-requests-nimble-20261027.csv) and the routing decision snippet (routing-log-snippet-20261027.csv). We're happy to provide any additional logs you need for your internal reconciliation.

4) Controls: we've disabled the transient fallback policy for your org pending your sign-off, and engineering will follow up on a long-term safe-guard (explicit opt-in for auxiliary routing + alerting when routing deviates).

Please reply to confirm NimbleApps accepts the credit so we can apply it and unblock AP. If you'd rather escalate to procurement/legal because of the SOW language, we will of course accommodate that process.

Thanks again — I know AP timelines are tight.

Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.com

Attachments: proposed-credit-20261112.pdf
